candidates.name: SynthPanel
candidates.role: Synthetic focus groups for positioning, pricing, objections, and persona probes.
candidates.recommended_use: Use as the first virtual-user skill runner. All reports must be labeled synthetic.

candidates.name: Magentic Marketplace
candidates.role: Buyer/seller agent market simulation for marketplace, negotiation, and manipulation tests.
candidates.recommended_use: Use as research lab for customer-vendor-agent market behavior, not first production dependency.

candidates.name: AgentSociety
candidates.role: Large-scale social simulation for behavior and group dynamics.
candidates.recommended_use: Track as advanced research option; do not integrate in first wave.

candidates.name: Y Social
candidates.role: Social media simulation for brand perception and spread dynamics.
candidates.recommended_use: Use only for research; GPL license and low maturity are blockers for product integration.

candidates.name: Crawl4AI
candidates.role: LLM-friendly crawler that produces clean markdown and structured extraction artifacts.
candidates.recommended_use: Default Jinyiwei crawler for source-attributed market and competitor briefs.

candidates.name: Scrapling
candidates.role: Adaptive Python web scraping framework with fetchers, spiders, smart selectors, MCP, JSON/JSONL export, and optional stealth/dynamic fetching.
candidates.recommended_use: Evaluate as Jinyiwei's Python adaptive crawler for public-source briefs; disable stealth/anti-bot features by default and require robots/ToS guardrails.

candidates.name: Firecrawl
candidates.role: Search, scrape, crawl, and web interaction API at scale.
candidates.recommended_use: Evaluate as isolated service/API only; AGPL is a product-integration risk.

candidates.name: Crawlee
candidates.role: Production crawler queue with Cheerio support.
candidates.recommended_use: Use when Jinyiwei needs recurring queues, proxy rotation, and TS crawler operations.

candidates.name: Scrapy
candidates.role: Mature Python crawling framework for stable large-scale crawling.
candidates.recommended_use: Use for stable sites and data pipelines, not AI-first markdown extraction.

candidates.name: promptfoo
candidates.role: Prompt, agent, RAG testing and red-team scans.
candidates.recommended_use: Use as first red-team harness for legal swarm and fact-number invariants.

candidates.name: DeepEval
candidates.role: LLM evaluation framework for repeatable metrics and regression tests.
candidates.recommended_use: Use for Python-side swarm regression tests after promptfoo red-team cases are defined.

candidates.name: Phoenix
candidates.role: AI observability, tracing, datasets, experiments, and evals.
candidates.recommended_use: Use as observability candidate if current run logs are insufficient.

candidates.name: Future AGI
candidates.role: End-to-end agent eval, simulations, guardrails, gateway, and traces.
candidates.recommended_use: Track; nightly/early-stage warning makes it second-wave, not first-wave.
